cards.text: This is the testimony of John, the man sent from God to testify about the Light (John 1:6-7). The Jews of Jerusalem send priests and Levites to ask him one question: “Who are you?” Friend, that's a whole delegation for a question you could've sent in a group chat.

cards.question: John doesn't refuse to answer. When the priests and Levites ask who he is, what does John openly declare?

answers.text: I am a king of Israel

cards.text: So they start guessing: is he Elijah the prophet (1 Kings 18:36)? John says, “I am not.”

cards.question: True or false: When the visitors ask John if he is the Prophet, he says yes.

cards.text: Three questions, three NOS, and they still need an answer for the people who sent them. I think they're picturing walking into the boss's office with a report that just says, "No. No. No."

cards.question: So the visitors ask John what he says about himself. John answers in the words of ___ the prophet.

cards.text: John says he is “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’” They asked for a name, friend, and he handed them a verse from Isaiah.

cards.question: John calls himself a voice in the wilderness, calling out to make straight the way for the Lord. So what does John say his job is?

answers.text: Getting the way ready for the Lord
Ruling Israel in the Lord's place
Judging the priests for the Lord

cards.text: Then the Pharisees who had been sent step up, from the strictest group in the Jewish faith (Acts 26:5). They've got one more question for John.

cards.question: The Pharisees ask John, “Why then do you ___, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”

cards.text: John answers, “I baptize with water,” but he isn't done. Then he tells them about One who is standing among them right now.

cards.question: John tells the Pharisees about One who stands among them. What does John say about them and this One?

cards.text: This One comes after John, and John says he isn't worthy to untie the straps of His sandals. Friend, that's the job NOBODY fights over, and John says he doesn't even qualify for it.

cards.question: John says he isn't worthy to untie the straps of this One's sandals. What does that show about this One?

answers.text: He is far greater than John
He is a servant like John
He has traveled a long way

cards.question: The visitors came from Jerusalem to question John. True or false: All of this happens in Jerusalem.

cards.text: The next day, John sees Jesus coming toward him. After all those nos, friend, John finally gets to point at somebody and say YES.

cards.question: When John sees Jesus coming toward him, what does John call Him?
True or false: John says the Lamb of God takes away the sin of the world.

cards.text: Then John points back to something he said before. This is the man he meant, the one who comes after John but has surpassed him.

cards.question: John says the man who comes after him has surpassed him. What reason does John give?

cards.text: Then John says, “I myself did not know Him” and friend, he JUST introduced the man! Now he says THAT?

cards.question: John says he didn't know Jesus himself. So why does John say he came baptizing with water?

answers.text: So He might be revealed to Israel
So the priests would accept John
So the Pharisees would listen to John

cards.text: Then John testifies about something he saw with his own eyes.

cards.question: John says, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a ___ and resting on Him.”

cards.text: A dove, friend, the same shape as my little Minty, and trust me, she'd want you to know that. Then John says that line again: “I myself did not know Him”
But the One who sent John to baptize with water gave him a sign to watch for. It's the man John sees the Spirit come down on and rest on.

cards.question: True or false: The One who sent John told him the man the Spirit rests on will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
John has seen the sign and testified about it. Who does John say Jesus is?

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 5 quotes "No. No. No.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: "Three questions, three NOS" is not accurate. Before verse 22, the delegation asks four questions: "Who are you?" (1:19), "Then who are you?", "Are you Elijah?" and "Are you the Prophet?" (1:21). John gives three no answers, but not to three questions. Reword the line so it counts only what is true, for example "Three NOs in a row."

rule.text: Noticing: What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match.

findings.problem: Nothing before this card mentions baptizing. Card 1 says John testifies, card 7 calls him a voice in the wilderness, and no card says he baptizes. The blank sits inside the Pharisees' exact words, and "preach" and "prophesy" fit everything the baker has been told. So the baker can only get it right by luck or by already knowing it. Card 9 should set up that John is baptizing people, or the card should ask something the baker can reason out.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

findings.problem: The blank tests wording from a line the baker hasn't seen, not meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The stop never tells the baker where this happens. The true/false card only shows that it isn't Jerusalem, and no story card follows it, so Bethany beyond the Jordan (1:28) is never told. Ask where it happens, or add a story card that names the place.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: This card is the first time Jesus shows up in the passage, but it doesn't say who He is. Use a simple description that gives away no later answers. For example, "Jesus of Nazareth" (John 1:45) gives nothing away, while "God's Son" would give away card 13.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
